description: This file is a shell script containing test cases related to optional configuration paths within a Git project. It defines several test scenarios to verify behavior of optional paths in git config, utilizing shell commands and test framework functions.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets up or verifies configuration values for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a success criterion for a test case, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the following command should fail.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in the output or file.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes, typically for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.
